evidence.observation: T701 reads 437.2 °C while T702, T703 and T712 read 69.5, 69.9 and 63.7 °C; the extreme reboiler-temperature discrepancy is present from the first event.

The discrepancy persists: T701 is 441.5 °C versus T702 73.6, T703 70.9 and T712 63.3 °C. These readings cannot distinguish actual excessive reboiler temperature from a sensor or data-conversion fault.
Reflux and distillate flows are 0.8 and 1.2 L/h, while the reported flow ratio is 6.8; this does not match their instantaneous ratio and requires verification of ratio definition and timing.
System pressure remains near 500 mbar (499.7); differential pressures are 0.7 and 3.1 mbar and both level switches remain 1. These channels do not corroborate a specific leak or blockage.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler-temperature measurement, T701 calibration and raw-signal/scaling checks, operating protocol and safe temperature limits; FYI702 definition and synchronized flow verification; composition measurements and target specification to assess separation.
